train: 192 novel seeded fabrics each with a random macro-action, plus 8 no-movement examples
test: 16 different asset/target seeds, 12 action choices per asset including no movement and geometric folding; all arms see identical choices
success: final six-frame mean native-vertex RMS to ideal reflected fold <= 5% of length
both grasp corner errors <= 10% of length
native_task_score: minimize RMS shape error / length + positive(95th-percentile-height - 0.035)/length + positive(max grasp-corner error / length - 0.10); same objective for model and Newton candidate ranking
surrogate: task-conditioned RBF trajectory model, conditional on initial geometry, material, release schedule and an open-loop grasp macro-action. Fixed fit using only training data. Full native relative XYZ shape history predicted per candidate.
safety_checks: Report support, final edge stretch, terminal interlayer order and non-adjacent triangle intersection diagnostics; no exact self-collision guarantee.
